environment.description: Application deployed on an EC2 instance behind a basic Network Load Balancer (NLB) with TCP passthrough on port 443. No application-layer inspection. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. The Flask app runs directly via gunicorn with no middleware. SQLite database at /data/app.db contains production user records and API keys.

config.load_balancer: AWS NLB, TCP mode, no TLS termination at LB
